source.source_name: Shopify developer changelog: external brands in Catalog API beta (2026-10-27)
source.purpose: Prevent video_shopify from treating beta external catalog products as Shopify-native checkout or worldwide availability
source.cost_quota: free public official documentation; no key or paid credits
source.reliability_limits: Beta feature; external products currently appear only for US shoppers. External product data is sourced from brand websites, links to off-platform checkout, and is not eligible for native Shopify checkout or Promoted Placements commission.

learning.title: Shopify Catalog API external brands beta: US-only, no native checkout or commission
learning.claim: Shopify's Catalog API beta announced 2026-10-27 that search_catalog accepts sources=['shopify','external'] or ['external'] to include products from brands not selling on Shopify; without sources it remains Shopify-only. External products have eligible.native_checkout=false and do not earn Promoted Placements commission. During beta, external results are available only for US shoppers; non-US searches continue to return Shopify merchant products.
learning.decision: SHOPIFY_CATALOG_EXTERNAL_US_ONLY_NO_CHECKOUT_GATE: video_shopify must not count Catalog API external products as Shopify-native-checkout inventory or Promoted Placements revenue. If an authorized app uses search_catalog and targets US shoppers, explicitly set sources and display external off-platform links; for non-US shoppers or apps not using Catalog API, REVIEW_ONLY/no changes. Never publish products or charge without separate approval.
learning.next_measurement: Read video_shopify code and current API usage for search_catalog; record found/not-found. If found, test sources omitted versus ['shopify','external'] with US/non-US buyer context and assert eligible.native_checkout=false for external products; attach actual decision/manifest applied_learning_ids and a new-head CI run before claiming applied.
failure_history: 2026-10-27 intake/promotions/2026-10-27-research-learner-video_shopify.json was headline-only and unverified; this independent official article read adds region, checkout and commission constraints without rewriting the intake record.
fallback_history: If Catalog API is not used or buyer context cannot be verified, keep the learning REVIEW_ONLY and do not alter catalog, Shopify products or checkout.
